summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) preliminary prospectus supplement for a global offering of ordinary shares (including ADSs) and pre-funded warrants. The offering consists of a U.S. public offering of ADSs and a European offering of shares and pre-funded warrants; the number of shares is subject to reallocation. The last prices were €38.48 per share on Euronext Paris and $46.20 per ADS on Nasdaq. Pre-funded warrants have a €0.03 exercise price and a ten-year term with a beneficial ownership cap. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
